title: Rotor workflow, version 1
description: A workflow Rotor runs as the person who starts it. docs/workflows.md explains every field.

name.description: Lower case letters, digits and dashes, as a file name would be.

inputs.description: A JSON Schema for what the person gives when starting a run; checked before the run starts.

tools.description: The tools a run may use, each under a name the nodes refer to.

maxCost.description: The most the run's model calls may cost, in US dollars, at the prices an administrator set for the model.

maxConcurrent.description: How many runs of this workflow may be starting or running at once; more wait, queued.

toolCallsPerMinute.description: How many tool calls the run may make in any minute; 60 when unset.

retention.description: How long a finished run's data is kept before Rotor deletes it, such as 30d. The installation's retention wins when it is shorter (#41).

triggers.description: Reserved and empty: triggers are records each person makes in Rotor, starting the workflow as them (docs/api-contract-m6.md).

id.description: Starts with a lower case letter, then letters, digits, dashes or underscores.

duration.description: A whole number of seconds, minutes or hours, such as 30s, 10m or 2h.

days.description: A whole number of days, such as 30d.

statePath.description: Where a value lives in the run's state: inputs.<field>, nodes.<node>.<field>, or visits.<node> (#134).

schema.description: A JSON Schema the node's output must satisfy.

tool.description: The tool's name in Rotor, such as exciter.

allowTools.description: The MCP tools a run may call through this binding; nothing else is offered.

access.description: read offers only the tools that say they only read.

approval.description: beforeWrite requires an approval node on every path to a node that writes through this binding.

unattended.description: Calls of allowTools a triggered run may make with no approval before them, once the trigger's owner agrees to each.

repository.description: A repository the tool connects to a project, which workspaces check out (#137); each may be a template of inputs.

workspace.description: The run's branch of a repository binding, checked out for the step in a toolchain image (#136).

image.description: An image name an administrator allows.

access.description: write commits and pushes the branch when the step ends.

maxVisits.description: How often the node may run; the visit past it goes to onExhausted (#134).

onExhausted.description: Where the run goes when maxVisits is used up; without it the run fails.

join.description: all runs the node once every branch into it has ended (#135).

model.description: The node's own model; the workflow's without one (#133).

role.description: Who the agent is, under Rotor's fixed policy; never a template (#133).

maxSteps.description: The agent's own step cap, at most the workflow's (#133).

maxVisits.description: How often the node may run; the visit past it goes to onExhausted (#134).

onExhausted.description: Where the run goes when maxVisits is used up; without it the run fails.

join.description: all runs the node once every branch into it has ended (#135).

arguments.description: The call's arguments; a string may hold {{ inputs.x }} or {{ nodes.n.x }} to put a value of the state in.

source.description: Python defining def run(state, ctx) -> dict.

group.description: A group of the identity provider; only its members decide. Without approvers, the person who started the run decides.

expiresIn.description: How long the approval waits before it expires and ends the run; at most 168h.

schema.description: A JSON Schema object; its properties are the fields an approver may change.

values.description: What the run proposes for each field; a string may hold {{ inputs.x }} or {{ nodes.n.x }}.

cases.description: Which node follows for each value the state holds at on.
